<a id="end_scene_ptrs"></a>
### [`end_scene_ptrs`](../../../../src/story/end_scene.asm#L6) `$CC9D-$CCA4`

*data*

Figure records of the final stage: Drax stands, Drax throws, the princess, a princess variant. $8e17 selects one with final_scene_pose.

- **Read by:** [`set_end_figure`](end_figure.md#set_end_figure)

<a id="end_scene_0"></a>
### [`end_scene_0`](../../../../src/story/end_scene.asm#L9) `$CCA5-$CCB0`

*data*

Sprite set-up, 12 bytes: animations of sprites 3-0, X positions of sprites 3-0, Y positions minus $a2.

- **Entry of:** [`end_scene_ptrs`](../../tables.md#end_scene_ptrs)

### [`end_scene_3`](../../../../src/story/end_scene.asm#L16) `$CCC9-$CCD4`

*data*

No code writes 3 to final_scene_pose, so nothing reads this record. No other record of this table uses animation $8e (shape $56).

<a id="bolt_motions"></a>
### [`bolt_motions`](../../../../src/story/end_scene.asm#L19) `$CCD5-$CCD6`

*data*

Start motion of the bolt (sprite 4). $84ac selects one of the 2 entries with bit 0 of the raster line.

- **Read by:** [`final_stage_attack`](final_stage.md#final_stage_attack)

<a id="bolt_pass_move_ptrs"></a>
### [`bolt_pass_move_ptrs`](../../../../src/story/end_scene.asm#L22) `$CCD7-$CCDA`

*data*

Pointers to a list of 4 moves for each bolt motion. When fighter 0 does one of these moves, the bolt passes and stops.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_contact`](final_stage.md#check_attack_contact)
